📖 How to use

  1. Pick “Vs computer” or “Two players”.
  2. Click a square — X moves first.
  3. The AI answers with the perfect minimax move.
  4. Wins, draws and the winning line are tracked below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the computer really unbeatable?

It uses the minimax algorithm, which explores every possible game. Played perfectly it can never lose — the best you can do is a draw.

Can two people play?

Yes — switch to “Two players” and pass the device back and forth. X always moves first.

Why is the computer's move instant?

Minimax evaluates the whole game tree (at most a few thousand positions), so the move is instant.
